narrative:
Wood County has 88,741 registered voters, with 56.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 19.5%, a modest Republican lean of 4.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 26.7% of registrants.
